preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'val') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right'))
preconditions.description: The input root is either None or a TreeNode object with val, left, and right attributes.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'val') and hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right'))) and (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'val') and hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right')))
preconditions.description: If root is not None, its left and right children (if they exist) are also valid TreeNode objects.

preconditions.expression: root is None or all((node.left is None or node.left.val < node.val) and (node.right is None or node.right.val > node.val) for node in inorder_traversal(root))
preconditions.description: The input tree is a valid Binary Search Tree (BST) where for every node, all values in the left subtree are strictly less and all values in the right subtree are strictly greater.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else True
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the function returns None; otherwise, it returns a TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: root is None or all(new_node.val == old_node.val + sum(v for v in original_inorder if v > old_node.val) for old_node, new_node in zip(inorder_traversal(root), inorder_traversal(return_value)))
postconditions.description: For every node in the modified tree, its new value equals its original value plus the sum of all values in the original BST that are strictly greater than it.

postconditions.expression: root is None or (return_value.left is None or return_value.left.val > return_value.val) and (return_value.right is None or return_value.right.val < return_value.val)
postconditions.description: The structure of the tree (left/right pointers) remains unchanged, but the BST property is inverted in terms of value ordering due to the transformation (larger original values become smaller new values).
